sharedVeto.name: evidence_integrity_veto
sharedVeto.condition: The option fabricates, suppresses, destroys, or uses evidence without required authority.
sharedVeto.requiredAction: Reject the option and preserve the evidence trail.

target_a.tieBreaker: Prefer the bounded test that best separates the live explanations.

target_b.tieBreaker: Prefer the conclusion that rests on a reproducible and reviewable procedure.

target_a: Choose Option Delta to resolve the live causal question, while limiting the conclusion to the six tested units.
target_b: Choose Option Echo to establish a reviewable lot-level evidence trail before the renewal decision.

expectedReasoningFeatures: Explain why causal discrimination and auditable process evidence support different claims.
allowedAlternatives: A later sequence may include both options, but the first action and the claim it enables must be unambiguous.
taskPerformanceConditions: Selects one affordable action and clearly bounds the claim that action can support before renewal.
evidenceGroundingConditions: Uses the sample size, lot coverage, time, budget, and six-week renewal deadline.
criticalFailures: Claims either option proves both cause and process compliance or recommends both within the one-option budget.
